headline: IPCA Laboratories reports a 32.5% jump in Q2 net profit
hook: Strong export growth lifts quarterly profit
summary: IPCA Laboratories posted a net profit of ₹375 crore for the second quarter, marking a 32.5% year-on-year increase driven by strong export growth. Revenue rose 13.8% to ₹2,910 crore, while EBITDA margin improved to 23%. This performance came despite its subsidiary Unichem recognizing a ₹24.26-crore provision for a UK legal claim. Indian retail investors holding pharmaceutical stocks can view this as a sign of resilient export demand and margin expansion for mid-cap drugmakers.
why_it_matters: Stronger export margins boost sentiment for mid-cap pharma stocks
winners_losers: IPCA Labs gains / Unichem hurt by legal provision

headline: Nifty Pharma index hits record high led by Sun, Laurus, Zydus, and Sai
